name: ftu-glomerulus
title: FTU Glomerulus — 3D Functional-Tissue-Unit Digital Object
question:
Does the HRA CDN's glomerulus 3D functional-tissue-unit (FTU) digital
object load into a Step-driven composite, giving a sub-organ-scale 3D
asset (below the per-organ reference-organ GLBs) that could anchor
finer-grained model coverage?

study_card.goal: Fetch the glomerulus FTU digital object via HRAFtuStep and confirm the composite loads a non-empty ftu record with a resolvable GLB asset URL.
study_card.mechanism: HRAFtuStep.update -> fetch_ftu(slug='glomerulus') -> HRA CDN 3d-ftu/glomerulus digital object -> {slug, title, description, glb, glb_url} -> one store -> RAMEmitter.
study_card.expected_result: The glomerulus FTU record loads with a non-empty title/description and a glb_url pointing at the CDN's 3d-ftu/glomerulus/latest/assets/ directory.
study_card.main_expert_question: Are enough FTUs (beyond glomerulus) published at this digital-object shape to generalize sub-organ-scale model coverage, or is glomerulus a one-off?

biological_summary:
The glomerulus is the kidney nephron's filtration unit — capillary tuft
plus Bowman's capsule — far smaller than the whole-kidney reference-organ
GLB the HRA otherwise publishes. HRA's 3D functional-tissue-unit (FTU)
digital objects capture this sub-organ scale directly, which matters for
DynXR-style spatially-grounded modeling: a mechanistic model of
glomerular filtration should anchor to the glomerulus FTU mesh, not just
a "kidney" whole-organ label. This study confirms that digital object is
live-fetchable and asks whether the shape generalizes beyond this one FTU.
readouts: ftu.glb_url resolves under the 3d-ftu/glomerulus CDN path

report.title: FTU Glomerulus — digital object loads (v1.0, ~143 MB GLB)
report.objective:
Does the HRA CDN's glomerulus 3D FTU digital object load into a
Step-driven composite, giving a sub-organ-scale 3D asset with a
resolvable GLB asset URL?
report.conclusion:
The live composite loads the glomerulus FTU record: title "glomerulus
(v1.0) graph data", description "The graph representation of the 3D
Glomerulus Functional Tissue Unit (FTU) dataset", version v1.0
(published 2026-06-08 by HuBMAP, CC BY 4.0), resolving to
`glomerulus.glb` at
`cdn.humanatlas.io/digital-objects/3d-ftu/glomerulus/latest/assets/glomerulus.glb`
— confirmed live (HTTP 200, ~150.4 MB / ~143.4 MiB). The FTU digital-object
shape (`{data:[glb], metadata:{title, description, version, ...}}`)
parses cleanly into the expected `ftu` record.
report.caveat:
The HRA CCF resolver (`purl.humanatlas.io/3d-ftu/<slug>/latest`) 404s
on a bare `Accept: */*` request and only 200s with an explicit
`Accept: application/json` header — an upstream content-negotiation
quirk, not a data-shape problem; `hra_api.fetch_ftu` was updated to
send that header so the live fetch actually resolves (previously this
composite would fail end-to-end against the current live API). Only
one FTU (glomerulus) is exercised here — whether the HRA has published
others at this same digital-object shape (the study's main expert
question) is not yet checked.
